summary: Deprecates the RC4 stream cipher in Secure Shell and, as a result, moves RFC 4345 to Historic status. It is a best-practice document recommending that SSH implementations stop using RC4 because of its weaknesses.

eli5.summary: An old lock has been found easy to pick, so this says to stop using it for remote logins and replace it with better ones.

questions: should rc4 be used in ssh
why was rc4 deprecated in ssh
